gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (governmental funds: General, Economic Development, Lottery, LB 840) Total expenditures 805,274; the per-fund schedule lines in detail add to exactly that (General 697,682 pp15-16, Economic Development 25,547 p19, LB 840 82,045 p20, Lottery 0). The extra 41,014 is the last two detail lines (detail[145] 'Nursing Home Bonds' 27,418 and detail[146] 'Airport' 13,596), taken from the Combined Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Budget and Actual - All Fund Types p13, whose 'Total governmental funds' actual is 1,122,064 (it also includes Transfer to other funds 275,776 and these two budgeted items). Neither amount appears in any p5 column, so they are not duplicates of statement money: the all-fund-types budget schedule covers items outside the governmental funds statement. 27,418 + 13,596 = 41,014 = amount by which the schedule is above the statement. No fix (lines are printed actuals and not double counted).
